svg.title: Selected public-repository commits, daily values
svg.desc: Accessible two-dimensional calendar. All 365 dated cells from 31 Oct 2025 to 30 Oct 2026, including zero-count days, are shown. Total 195 commits across 29 active days. Source scope: Distinct commits linked to DoArtMonteiro on selected public repositories' default branches; dated by author timestamp in UTC. This is a subset of GitHub activity, not the full profile graph. This aggregate does not measure work quality or intensity.
svg.text: Data through 30 Oct 2026 · 195 commits across 29 active days; 365 dated days.

Source scope: Distinct commits linked to DoArtMonteiro on selected public repositories' default branches; dated by author timestamp in UTC. This is a subset of GitHub activity, not the full profile graph. All dated days are shown, including zero-count days.
Daily-count ranges are shown above. Aggregate counts do not measure work quality or intensity.
